narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Pyramids are about adding, so ten plus four means the empty middle block is fourteen.
<bookmark mark='test'/>Test it. Four plus fourteen makes eighteen, but the top cup says ten.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>A cup below is only a part of the cup above, so it must be smaller.

narration: <bookmark mark='think'/>Going down a pyramid, take away. Going back up, add to check your work.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. The top is nine, the middle row has five, and the bottom row starts with two. Fill it.
